answer: I found two help-center articles that name form NW-LSE-1, and both would need an update if it were retired. "Selling a car that you lease" describes signing the lease buyout authorization, form NW-LSE-1, so Northwind can request the dealer payoff quote from the leasing company. "Getting a payoff letter from your lender" says NW-LPA-1 is for loans only and points lease customers to "Selling a car that you lease" and form NW-LSE-1. Some other lease articles, such as "What to bring to your appraisal appointment", talk about the dealer payoff quote but don't name the form, so they wouldn't need changes for this.
